companyContext: French parent group that owns Kusmi Tea since 2003. Originally cotton, non-ferrous metals, and then cocoa/coffee merchants (Orebi family), the group pivoted into premium tea and built Kusmi Tea into an international tea house with workshops in Saint-Vigor d'Ymonville, near Le Havre in Normandy, and headquarters in Paris.
brandContext: Kusmi Tea is a French premium tea house founded in 1867 in Saint Petersburg by Pavel Kousmichoff and re-established in Paris in 1917. B Corp certified, made in Normandy, the maison creates organic blends of black, green, white, matcha, rooibos and herbal teas — a free-spirited, modern and inclusive vision of tea distributed in around 100 boutiques worldwide.
campaignContext: promotion du thé vert matcha premium

brandVision: Cultivate a free spirit through tea — break the rules of etiquette without ever compromising on quality. Kusmi sees tea as inclusive, joyful and resolutely modern: organic, creative and accessible blends imagined in Normandy that revolutionize the art of blending and unite novices and connoisseurs around the universal emotion of pleasure.
brandValues: Freedom of taste and creation; organic and natural ingredients; French savoir-faire made in Normandy (Le Havre); B Corp commitment to people and the planet; gender equality and women-focused causes (Ruban Rose); reduction of plastic packaging; ARRONDI micro-donations; heritage since 1867 reinterpreted with daring modernity, gourmandise and optimism.
